sentences.en: Please ensure the genitals are obscured by a mosaic effect.
sentences.zh: 请确保生殖器区域被马赛克效果遮挡。

sentences.en: I will ensure that your salary increases after one year.
sentences.zh: 我将确保一年后你的工资会增加。

sentences.en: Following political independence, Algeria's policies tried to ensure economic independence.
sentences.zh: 在政治独立之后，阿尔及利亚的政策试图确保经济独立。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（使…）+sure（确定的）→使确定→保证
